name: Camera
description: Windows MDM settings in the Camera category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Allow Camera
properties.description: Disables or enables the camera. Most restrictive value is Block

properties.name: Configure Camera Options
properties.description: This policy will allow camera mode to be managed by IT admins and enable camera to run in safe or auto share mode.

enum.description: AutoShare - Allow camera access by multiple applications simultaneously.
SafeMode - The camera is configured to auto‑share and operate in a non‑accelerated mode, bypassing OEM/IHV‑provided plugins where applicable.
